identity_notes: A growth hormone-releasing hormone analog. Geref (sermorelin acetate) was FDA approved but is discontinued from marketing per Drugs@FDA. It remains a component of a previously approved drug.

status_assertions.qualification: Geref (sermorelin acetate) was approved in 1990 but is listed as discontinued from marketing in Drugs@FDA. No currently marketed FDA-approved sermorelin product was identified.
Sermorelin acetate appears in FDA's 503B Category 1 list marked as a component of an FDA-approved drug. Other 503B conditions, including the 'not essentially a copy' restriction, still apply.

timeline.title: Geref approved
timeline.description: FDA approved Geref (sermorelin acetate) for evaluating pituitary growth hormone reserve.

timeline.title: FDA warning letter cites sermorelin products
timeline.description: Xcel Research warning letter states sermorelin products marketed online are unapproved new drugs.
